visual.alt: Four checks from health through iframe acknowledgement

content.title: Health, token, and iframe handoff checks
content.subtitle: Capture status codes, booleans, and evidence locations rather than secrets.

steps.label: 1. Health
steps.text: Confirm expected safe readiness booleans for client ID, tenant, scope, and authentication mode.

steps.label: 2. Connect identity
steps.text: Verify an authenticated Connect user is required before the token endpoint responds.

steps.label: 3. Token route
steps.text: Observe success or sanitized failure. Do not display, log, or save the token value.

steps.label: 4. Iframe protocol
steps.text: Confirm configured origin, nonce-matched acknowledgment, and clean listener shutdown.

claims.statement: The host code exposes boolean readiness fields, requires a Posit Connect identity, sanitizes provider errors, and the iframe tests enforce exact-origin plus nonce checks.

talkTrack: A green health response alone does not prove EDAV accepted the token.
The evidence record must not contain the token.
evidence: app.py, entra_auth.py, microbot.js, and selected tests
caveats: Only a real EDAV handoff validates audience, scope, and bot acceptance.
